faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins is 50 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $3.15/pc (50 pcs starter tier), $2.05/pc (500 pcs tier), and $1.48/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins is $110 Die (Waived @ 1,000+ pcs). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins?
faqs.answer: Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins is custom-engineered from Solid Brass / Zinc Alloy using Galvo Fiber Laser Edge or Face Serialization (001/500), sized around Ø44.5×3.5mm (1.75") at approximately 45g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Antique Gold / Silver / Bronze. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with Clear Acrylic Capsule + Velvet Box Opt.. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins completes in 10–14 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Sequential Laser-Numbered Edition Coins can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
